lines: So in articulation-rest: the supreme pulsation,
the already-dawned — that triad of marks we will
l4.sanskrit_cite: evam uccāraviśrāntau yat paraṃ spandanaṃ galitāśeṣavedyaṃ yac ca unmiṣad vedyaṃ yac ca unmiṣitavedyaṃ tad eva liṅgatrayam iti vakṣyāmaḥ svāvasare
